scope: Offline official Kronos LoRA training and chronological evaluation components
implemented: Pinned local official model/tokenizer and frozen vendor source identities, isolated lazy imports with source bytecode disabled
Frozen tokenizer exact prefix invariance verification before fitting or evaluation
Origin-only direction and W32/ICT/native CZSC internal heads; continuous-only native CZSC head supported
Future-only shifted AR s1 and causal s2 objectives plus train-only scaled masked Huber/BCE and frozen original-backbone KL
Explicit new-candidate optimizer execution guarded by execution_enabled; tune-only checkpoint selection
Actual LoRA/head/optimizer checkpoint without copying official base or tokenizer tensors
Exact dataset/config/schema/assets/runtime binding checks on reload
Separate tune/calibration/policy/holdout evaluation with global valid-element loss denominators and train direction-prior/frozen-token baselines

checks: future perturbation cannot alter causal s2 prefix or origin heads
masked evaluation losses invariant to batch composition
continuous-only heads and unknown target denominators

limitations: No optimizer resume, standalone merged export, calibration fitting, trading policy or backtest implemented
Small pilot completion does not establish model quality or authorize promotion
